verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It shows that each noncentral element has a conjugacy class whose size is a positive power of p, applies the class equation to deduce that p divides |Z(G)|, and then uses |Z(G)| >= p >= 2 to obtain a nonidentity central element. The statement is self-contained, and the proof contains no external references, signed fact citations, or hard-prohibition violations.
